item.title: Workshop Flyer Missing Its Date

turns.text: Make a portrait 4:5 flyer for our Pottery Workshop at Clay House Studio, 14:00–16:00. It needs the event date on it too. Add 'Beginners welcome'. Soft earthy colours and a simple drawing of a clay bowl, please. No other wording.

must_haves: The completed flyer shows the user-confirmed date exactly as '24 July 2027', not a guessed date or placeholder.
The time and venue read exactly '14:00–16:00' and 'Clay House Studio'.
The flyer includes exactly 'Beginners welcome' and no additional wording.
The portrait 4:5 design uses soft earthy colours and a simple clay bowl illustration.

dialog.agent: What date should appear on the flyer?
dialog.why: It asks the user to provide the date for the flyer and waits for an answer.

dialog.agent:
Thanks—the date will be **24 July 2027**.

The connected image generator doesn’t support exact **4:5** output. Would you prefer a **9:16 portrait flyer**, or a **square image with the design arranged for cropping to 4:5**? I’ll use only your requested wording.
dialog.why: It asks the user to choose between a 9:16 portrait flyer and a square image arranged for cropping to 4:5, then waits for their preference.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the generation because your account has insufficient credits, so no flyer was created.

I chose a square layout arranged for cropping to **4:5**, with soft earthy colours, a simple clay-bowl drawing, and only this wording:

**Pottery Workshop**  
Clay House Studio  
24 July 2027  
14:00–16:00  
Beginners welcome

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create a polished, beautifully typeset pottery workshop flyer inside a square image, with the ENTIRE flyer design contained in a centered portrait 4:5 rectangle spanning the full image height and central 80 percent of the image width. Outer left and right 10 percent margins must be plain matching background, without borders or crop marks, so this square image can be cropped to 4:5 without losing anything. Soft earthy colours: warm cream paper background, muted terracotta, sandy beige, subtle sage, dark warm brown lettering. Minimal elegant editorial design, generous whitespace, clear highly legible typography. Include a simple charming hand-drawn line illustration of a handmade clay bowl in terracotta, no other objects required. The ONLY text in the image must be these exact five text elements, spelled accurately, arranged with tasteful visual hierarchy: 'Pottery Workshop', 'Clay House Studio', '24 July 2027', '14:00–16:00', 'Beginners welcome'. Pottery Workshop is the largest headline. No other wording, no logos, no watermarks, no invented location, no extra dates, no registration information. All lettering and the bowl illustration must remain comfortably within the central portrait 4:5 crop area with generous internal margins.
